title: Mate equality for proper-open comparison composition

from.place: Proof steps 3--5: composition of restriction maps, adjunction transpose and cancellation

statement: For proper maps f and g carrying a common open X to open immersions j₁, j₂, j₃, and for the canonical derived composition isomorphism c : Rf_* ⋙ Rg_* ≅ R(fg)_*, the composite with c⁻¹ and the successive comparison composite have equal mates under the derived adjunction j₃! ⊣ j₃⁻¹.

source.place: Proof steps 3–5: composition of restriction maps, adjunction transpose and cancellation

proof.text: Choose bounded-below injective representatives for the input and compute the restriction maps sectionwise along the canonical fibre-product sections. The fibre-product associator and the equalities j₁≫f=j₂ and j₂≫g=j₃ identify the successive restriction with the restriction for f≫g. The clopen-section calculation identifies each restriction on extension-by-zero inputs with the specified proper-open identification. Naturality at the comparison morphisms gives equality of the two restricted maps; applying the derived adjunction hom-equivalence yields the displayed equality of mates.

theorem properOpenComparison_comp_mate (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {T₁ T₂ T₃ X : Scheme.{u}} (f : T₁ ⟶ T₂) (g : T₂ ⟶ T₃)
    [IsProper f] [IsProper g]
    [((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f)).PreservesInjectiveObjects]
    (j₁ : X ⟶ T₁) (j₂ : X ⟶ T₂) (j₃ : X ⟶ T₃)
    [IsOpenImmersion j₁] [IsOpenImmersion j₂] [IsOpenImmersion j₃]
    (hf : j₁ ≫ f = j₂) (hg : j₂ ≫ g = j₃)
    (c : rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f ⋙
        rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g ≅
      rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (f ≫ g))
    (hc : c = Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompIso'
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f)
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g)
      (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f g))
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    let a := derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunctionPlus
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₃
    a.homEquiv _ _
        (properOpenComparison Λ (f ≫ g) j₁ j₃
          ((Category.assoc j₁ f g).symm.trans ((congrArg (· ≫ g) hf).trans hg)) K ≫
          c.inv.app
            ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
              K)) =
      a.homEquiv _ _
        (properOpenComparison Λ g j₂ j₃ hg K ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).map
            (properOpenComparison Λ f j₁ j₂ hf K))
